project.name: Kettlehill
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 4 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. Balmalcolm Den and Kingskettle visitor businesses are outside the strict hamlet boundary. Private houses and heritage records without visitor access do not create a destination score.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Kettlehill is retained for regional completeness, but a strict-boundary current-web audit found no independently visitable attraction, café-led daytime stop, maintained place-specific trail, public picnic facility, visitor car park or public toilet.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Dog access is limited or unconfirmed and no dedicated dog destination is assumed.
